title: fix(speech): complete short writes before verifying downloads
body:
## Problem

A short disk write can publish a truncated speech runtime or model as verified. The downloader hashes and counts the received network chunk, but a single `FileHandle.write` need not write that whole chunk.

A real loopback HTTP download of 8,192 bytes with a child-process file-size limit of 4,096 bytes currently returns success and renames a 4,096-byte destination.

## Approach

Await `FileHandle.writeFile` for each chunk before advancing progress. A failed write leaves the partial file available for the existing range-resume path and never publishes the destination.

## Changes

- Replace the single-write call with a complete-buffer write.
- Add a Linux regression that forces an actual short disk write, checks the saved prefix, and resumes through HTTP Range.
- Document the complete-write invariant in the speech spec.

### Validation

Bun 1.4.4 on Linux: the download suite changes from **6 passed / 1 failed** to **7 passed / 0 failed** (21 assertions). The separate native HTTP/OS-limit reproduction now reports `EFBIG`, leaves a 4,096-byte partial, and creates no destination.

Lint, server typecheck, dependency/boundary/seam/spec/i18n checks, compiler census, and the E2E web build passed.

**Required full gates remain incomplete; this is a prepared proposal.** Full typecheck cannot download the paired Hutch runtime (DNS `EAI_AGAIN`). Full unit testing finished with 24/26 tasks successful: server 2,860 passed / 7 skipped / 3 failed; two package-directory failures reproduce on the clean baseline under this workspace's parent Git directory. The watcher-latency failure (1,027 ms against a 1,000 ms limit) did not reproduce in the isolated baseline control and remains unresolved. A separate artifact-test failure from sparse checkout was corrected by checking out the missing action; its full package then passed 103 tests with 10 platform skips. Browser E2E could not start Chromium, and normal Playwright installation failed with an invalid downloaded archive.

## Screenshots

Not applicable — no frontend changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Fast gates pass: `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test`
- [ ] E2E suite passes for app-affecting changes (`bun run e2e`, or `bun run e2e:full` when touching agent behavior)
- [x] Before/after screenshots are included for frontend changes, or marked not applicable
- [x] Relevant `SPEC.md` / top-level specs updated to reflect any boundary, contract, or behavior change
- [x] I have read the [Contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
